purpose: Select digital products from proven demand rather than novelty.

G1_ORIGINAL_AND_LEGITIMATE.rule: We can build an original product for the same customer problem without copying protected files, branding, listing copy, images, proprietary data or creative expression.

G2_POSITIVE_UNIT_ECONOMICS.rule: A realistic market price can leave positive net cash after known marketplace/payment fees and expected support/refund burden.

G3_CREDIBLE_BUYER_REASON.rule: There is at least one credible reason a buyer could choose our implementation: workflow, usability, decision support, documentation, localization, integration, packaging, outcome or price/value.

DEMAND_EVIDENCE.description: Evidence that buyers already purchase this archetype or close substitutes.

SUCCESSFUL_SELLER_EVIDENCE.description: Multiple observable sellers/listings show material reviews, favorites or other purchase-proxy evidence.

CAPTURABILITY.description: Probability that a new professional entrant can capture a useful fraction of demand despite incumbents.

VALUE_ADD_HEADROOM.description: Room to improve the buyer outcome or reduce friction without requiring category invention.

MARGIN_POTENTIAL.description: Price band and digital cost structure support attractive net economics.

PRODUCTION_SPEED.description: Can be produced and QA'd within practical weekly capacity or by reusing validated internal assets.

BUNDLE_AND_EXPANSION.description: Can seed adjacent modules, bundles, verticals or localization.

PORTFOLIO_FIT.description: Reuses our audience, expertise, site, funnel or existing product assets.

evidence_rules: Paid-order evidence is strongest when directly observable from our own channels.
Marketplace review counts are purchase proxies, not exact sales counts.
Listing counts indicate supply/competition, not demand by themselves.
Search-result prominence is not proof of profitability.
Unknown private conversion and sales figures remain UNOBSERVED.
High competition does not automatically reduce a candidate below BUILD if demand and capturability remain strong.
Scores are frozen with the evidence date; later outcomes do not rewrite the original score.
tie_breakers: Greater reuse of validated internal assets
Stronger adjacency into future premium products and bundles
